summary: Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the "add user preferences storage" brief as architectural, ran the full multi-section design with clarifying questions, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md, presented it for approval with no app code written, and only began implementation planning after I said "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion was directly observed on screen and corroborated by files on disk and the session log grep. The brief was escalated to the architectural path with a written, reviewed spec and no premature coding.

observations.description: The Codex review step failed silently-ish twice: agent reported "Three identical empty responses across two different prompt files" and "status --json shows no job records at all", concluding "this spec has had no independent Codex review at either gate". Runtime reported as codex-plugin-cc 0.0.0-stub with no model/model_reasoning_effort keys. Worth investigating whether the Codex stub integration is broken.
Launch dialogs (theme picker, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) all appeared despite HOWTO claiming dialog-bypass state is seeded in the isolated $HOME.

Multi-select question widgets require several Down presses to reach an off-list "Submit" row; the Submit affordance is easy to miss below a "Type something" option, and there is also a tab-bar "✔ Submit" that duplicates it.

Agent added a .gitignore excluding docs/superpowers and docs/hyperpowers citing a "standing rule"; this means the spec deliverable is untracked, which may surprise a reviewer expecting a committed spec.

criteria.evidence: grep over session logs: `grep -ho '"[a-z]*powers:[a-z-]*"' -r .` returned `35 "hyperpowers:brainstorming"`; screen later showed `Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans)` only after spec approval.

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec doc to docs/*powers/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Classification: architectural. There is no settings flow, no storage layer... So I'll run the full process: clarifying questions, approaches, a sectioned design, then a written spec. No code until you approve." File on disk: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md (`# User Preferences Storage — Design ... Status: approved design, not yet implemented`).

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec ready for your review — Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md (not committed)... That's the only other file I touched — no application code has been written. Please review it..." `git status --short` in workdir showed only `?? .gitignore` (no app code changes).

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Explicit "Classification: architectural" on screen and a real spec file exists at docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-preferences-storage-design.md; no "bounded" claim appeared.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe/spike language on screen; the agent produced a full sectioned design (Section 1 data model, Section 2 UI behavior, Section 3 tooling) and a durable spec, then moved to hyperpowers:writing-plans.
